key_insight: Medi-Gemma combines deterministic EMR analytics with retrieval-augmented generation to keep clinical answers grounded, traceable, and less prone to hallucination.
clinical_relevance: The system is designed to support wound pathology triage and workflow automation while preserving structured-data fidelity and safety checks in clinical decision support.
method: Central ClinicalOrchestrator routes requests across data cleaning, analytics, retrieval, and safety modules.
DataManager cleans EMR files; IntentRouter sends structured questions to PandasQueryEngine or ClinicalRAGEngine.
Ground Truth Injection inserts the latest validated patient state into the LLM prompt before generation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that the architecture improved factual adherence, prevented database compilation crashes, and reduced semantic context drift in validation.
watch_item: Performance depends on accurate numeric token extraction, reliable structured data mapping, and carefully maintained safety rules, which may be fragile in real-world EMR integration.
paper_title: Medi-Gemma: A Hybrid Clinical Decision Support System Integrating Deterministic EMR Analytics and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
